editionLabel: Pull the Pin Games English fourth-edition rules, 2023
firstPlayerRule: The player who was most recently shot, in a game or in real life, takes the first turn.
clarifications: Play proceeds clockwise after each turn.

sources.title: Good Cop Bad Cop — Fourth Edition English Rules
